shared_elements: interlace or scroll pattern in border
vertical monumental slab format with figural panel
justification: Both depict frontal standing human figures on an upright slab surrounded by dense ornament, and both include a patterned border framing the figural field, which is about as generic a correspondence as monumental figural art can offer. Beyond that they differ sharply: A shows a single towering elaborately costumed figure engulfed in curvilinear masks and glyph-like blocks rendered in high relief with modelled detail, while B shows a group of small flat silhouetted figures with animal-headed profiles arranged in registers within a plaited-cord frame.
